Note: before the update, the officers who have not finished drawing the lottery turntable will draw as soon as possible, and the data will be cleared after the update.
Lucky draw
A new lottery has been opened. You are required to draw your favorite and clothes! Press F5 in the game to participate in the lucky draw.
Description of prize pool:
1. Before the lucky draw, you can choose No. 4, No. 5 and No. 6 from the optional column, and No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3 are fixed rewards.
2. The prize pool can draw 6 times, and each drawing consumes the corresponding number of keys according to the drawing times
3. Each sample is selected according to the pseudo-random order to obtain one commodity.
4. Average extraction probability of each commodity. That is to say, the probability of extracting each commodity for the first time is 1 / 6, the probability of extracting each commodity for the nth time is 1 / (6-n), and the probability of remaining commodities for the sixth time is 1.
After 5.6 times of extraction, a new round of extraction can be started.
Function optimization
1. The UI function panel is newly upgraded and the activity task panel is completely new. You can get rich rewards for completing daily active tasks and weekly active tasks.
2. F5 activities add lucky draw, cheer for you, shadow play, game optimization and improvement plan, anchor support plan and other panels off the shelves.
